# Pegasus Olsen (Peggy Holstein)

Despite her name, Pegasus Olsen is an Earth pony in *Friendship Is Magic*. She is Manehattan's retro office mare, modeled after Peggy Olson (Elisabeth Moss) from *Mad Men*, and is often associated with Business Savvy, the show's Don Draper homage. Look for her pale yellow-green coat, curled brown mane, light-blue eyes, coral hat and neck scarf, and green-and-white typewriter cutie mark. [Contemporary coverage of the homage](https://www.badtaste.it/articoli/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-crossover-mad-men).

[![Pegasus Olsen with Business Savvy — Hasbro / DHX Media, Friendship Is Magic S4E8](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/20/1761667__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_business%2Bsavvy_pegasus%2Bolsen_peggy%2Bholstein_pony_rarity%2Btakes%2Bmanehattan_cropped_don%2Bdraper_mad%2Bmen_telephone.png)](https://twibooru.org/1761667)

- **Naming:** Pegasus Olsen is the official Hasbro Wave 20 blind-bag merchandise name, not a name established in spoken television dialogue. Peggy Holstein is a fandom alias ([fandom tagging reference](https://twibooru.org/tags/pegasus%2Bolsen)). Her collector card associates her with Janine Manewitz; Business Savvy's card identifies them as coworkers.
- **Speaking:** She has a brief line, “Watch it!”, in *Made in Manehattan*. Her individual voice actor is unverified. [Episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s05e16&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic).
- **Other appearances:** *Trade Ya!*, *Equestria Games*, *Party Pooped*, *The Gift of the Maud Pie*, *The Saddle Row Review*, *Fake It 'Til You Make It*, and *Common Ground*. The [Mad Men ponies character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Mad_Men_ponies) also identifies her as a unicorn in IDW's *Micro-Series #8: Celestia* (2013), on the school committee, and as a patient in *Friends Forever #21*. The comic depiction does not establish an in-show transformation. [Comic issue credits](https://comicvine.gamespot.com/my-little-pony-micro-series-8-celestia/4000-425049/).

[![Hasbro Pegasus Olsen figure and official name card — photograph by Pixie Dust Dolls](https://i0.wp.com/www.pixiedustdolls.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/mlp-blind-bag-pegasus-olsen.jpg?resize=700%2C394)](https://www.pixiedustdolls.com/blind-bag-friday/)

## Important moments

- **The office cameo — [Rarity Takes Manehattan (S4E8)](https://iview.abc.net.au/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/series/4/video/ZW4152A008S00).** Her television debut alongside Business Savvy during the city musical sequence establishes the Peggy Olson visual joke. Timestamp unavailable.
- **Watch it! — [Made in Manehattan (S5E16)](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/season/5/episode/16).** She snaps at Applejack in a busy intersection, illustrating the city's hurried culture and giving this background mare a rare speaking moment. Timestamp unavailable.

She has no verified major character arc. I found no independently attributable fan artwork suitable for inclusion; the images above are a show capture and a collector photograph. The character wiki was available through indexed text, but direct access was restricted.
